title: Hanford complete material balance remains held after the Phase 57Z exact-evidence recheck
summary: The July 2026 Tri-Party Agreement report says the Waste Treatment Plant completed initial hot commissioning and progressed into extended hot commissioning, but it does not provide a complete input-to-output material balance. Decision: hold not resolved.
key_findings: Finding: The July 2026 Tri-Party Agreement report says the Waste Treatment Plant completed initial hot commissioning and progressed into extended hot commissioning, but it does not provide a complete input-to-output material balance.
